findings.description: The sidebar highlights Dashboard as the active navigation item by default, but the user requirement explicitly states Browse Catalog should be the initially selected/default item. The component initializes tab='dashboard' which maps to activeNav='dashboard', causing a visual mismatch.

The plan document acknowledged the navigation ambiguity and chose to default to Dashboard. However, the original user request is unambiguous: Browse Catalog must be the visually active item. Since Browse Catalog is an external link (to /), its active state can be independent of content view. Code should be corrected.

summary: 2-column layout is well-implemented with responsive design, proper component architecture, and all booking functionality preserved. TypeScript builds successfully. However, the default active navigation does not match the explicit requirement. Browse Catalog should be highlighted by default per the user brief, not Dashboard. This requires a state initialization change before the implementation can be approved.
